pairedTraces.method: Actual existing helper in-memory using frozen/current mode bytes, current identical CSS; seven established checkpoints. Normalization removes only width,height,padding,left,top from paper-card/photo styles and computed values. Every other node value, opacity, transform/rotation, resource admission/order, load, cursor and timer compared exactly.

review.reservation: Existing SS.photoLayoutArea reused; original COLS/ROWS/freeCells and selection preserved; area offsets and bounded paper-fit sizes are deliberate geometry change.
review.scatter: Rotation and numeric x/y biases sampled once per fresh photo; Number conversion preserves44 real fixture coercions and prevents redraw on reflow.
review.lifecycle: Resize listener coalesces with resizePending; existing owner t.frame holds while paused and ignores cancelled work; cleanup removes listener and clears owner before releasing every print. No new decode, selection or timer owner.
review.nonTarget: All bytes before Polaroid and after Mosaic header identical to frozen production baseline.

limits: Host generated reservation/lifecycle fixtures are bounded source evidence; native overlays, optimized runtime, clock appearance and device install outcomes remain coordinator-owned.
Fixed original grid count is retained across resize; no repacking/extra random selection claim.
Existing helper max32reservations/max16candidates and fallback behavior are unchanged; full-occluded/pathological tiny-area behavior is outside this correction.
No device, household, owner registry, provider/account, browser or network actions.
